description: Performs survival / time-to-event analysis using the lifelines library. Returns Kaplan-Meier survival curves, median survival times, log-rank test results, and hazard ratios by group. Useful for time-to-degree equity reporting and time-to-tenure analysis.

duration_column.description: Time-to-event or censoring column (numeric, in semesters or years)

event_column.description: Event observed indicator column (1 = event occurred, 0 = censored)

group_column.description: Grouping column for stratified analysis (e.g., demographic category)

confidence_level.description: Confidence interval level for survival curves
